_comment: Gate 0 v2 pre-registration precondition P9 (reports/2026-07-25-gate0-v2-prereg-DRAFT.md 4.1) -- the paid_gate0_v2-mode source-pins manifest eval/score_gate0.py::SOURCE_PIN_FILES['paid_gate0_v2'] expects. Same shape as gate0_paid_source_pins.json, pointing at the v2 attempt's own runs/gate0_paid_v2/<arm>/ output tree and its own FRESH held-out seed block. Exists because seeds 1000..1004 are SPENT (prereg 4: the v1 Arm W transcript with the correct checkbox answers is committed at reports/2026-07-24-gate0-paired-verdict/oracle.jsonl and is greppable), so a v2 attempt on them could not be reported as held-out generalization. paid_gate0 is untouched by this file -- the v1 result stays scoreable exactly as banked.
_source_frozen_seed_sha256: sha256 of eval/fixtures/gate0_miniwob_paid_v2_seeds.json ([417545,662948,660918,981149,558952]) as committed on this branch, matching eval.score_gate0.MODES['paid_gate0_v2'][0]. LF-canonical bytes (identical to the git blob): .gitattributes pins eval/fixtures/gate0_*.json to eol=lf, so every checkout on every platform materializes these exact bytes. DERIVATION (prereg 4.1.1, published formula, no post-hoc selection): candidate(i) = int.from_bytes(sha256(f'gate0-v2-armW:{i}'.encode()).digest()[:4],'big') % 1000000, walking i=0,1,2,...; a candidate is accepted only if it is not in {0..4} (dev seeds), not in {1000..1004} (spent), and not already accepted (no duplicates -- two identical seeds would collide in _miniwob_success's per-episode `row.get('seed') == seed` filter and corrupt both episodes' row sets). i=0..4 gave 417545/662948/660918/981149/189410, all accepted with zero rejections. Prereg 4.1.2 then BINDS the set to contain at least one six-checkbox layout (the layout P8 repairs, and the only one on which H-e is testable); an empirical reset-only render of all five in the miniwob-mcp-world image measured 5/5/2/2/3 checkboxes -- no six -- so per 4.1.2 the walk continued and the LAST accepted seed (189410) was REPLACED by the next accepted candidate that renders six: i=5 -> 751969 (5 boxes, passed over), i=6 -> 824167 (3, passed over), i=7 -> 567613 (2, passed over), i=8 -> 558952 (SIX, accepted). Final set 417545/662948/660918/981149/558952, checkbox counts 5/5/2/2/6, all distinct. THE SIX-CHECKBOX PREDICATE IS A PROPERTY OF THE WORLD IMAGE, SO THE IMAGE IS PINNED HERE -- see _measured_against below; without it a later reader re-measuring against a different image could legitimately derive a different fifth seed while believing they had followed the same rule.

_measured_against.method: reset-only render, no env.step(), no reward read, no episode played (prereg 4.1.2's '$0, no model call, no reward observed'); checkbox count = len(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]')).
_measured_against.note: The checkbox counts in _source_frozen_seed_sha256 (5/5/2/2/3 for i=0..4, 5/3/2/6 for i=5..8) were measured against the SUPERSEDED image id above. prereg P8 REBUILDS the world image before the v2 launch, which changes the image id but must NOT change the seed block: the seeds are frozen by frozen_seed_sha256 at launch and the draw is never re-run. If a post-P8 re-measurement disagrees about which seeds render six checkboxes, that is a finding to report against P8's rebuild -- NOT a licence to re-draw. Re-drawing after seeing a measurement is exactly the post-hoc selection prereg 4.1 exists to prevent.
_measured_against.re_measured_post_p8: RE-CONFIRMED 2026-07-28, after prereg P8's rebuild landed (PR #180, merge b890d8c). The five FROZEN seeds were re-rendered against the NEW image sha256:ee12a2f0e54a.. (tag miniwob-world; the miniwob-mcp-world tag PR #180 retired is stale by definition -- see DAVID_BASELINES.md:110-111), reset-only by the `method` above: no env.step(), no reward read, no last_info touched, no utterance printed, no episode played, $0, no model call. RESULT AGREES WITH THE FROZEN BLOCK EXACTLY -- 417545=5, 662948=5, 660918=2, 981149=2, 558952=SIX -- i.e. the recorded 5/5/2/2/6, with 558952 still the H-e test case. Submit's measured top y confirms prereg SS3's rendering table on the new image too: 2 boxes -> y=104, 5 -> y=161, 6 -> y=180, so 558952 still renders Submit 3px outside the 177px clickable band and H-e is still a live test. THE MEASUREMENT METHOD WAS VALIDATED BEFORE IT WAS TRUSTED: the identical script run against the SUPERSEDED image reproduced the same 5/5/2/2/6, so the agreement above is a fact about the two images, not an artifact of a new measuring instrument. miniwob 1.0 / selenium 4.21.0 / gymnasium 0.29.0 re-verified in-image and unchanged. No seed was changed, substituted, or re-drawn -- and none may be: per prereg 4.1.2 the recorded block binds, not the re-derivable rule.

_source_artifact_paths: red_human: SAME file as readiness_dev and paid_gate0 -- Red has no dev/paid seed split (reports/2026-07-13-minimum-north-star-gate-0-design.md:273, 'Red uses the same fixed start for agent and human') and DAVID_BASELINES.md names only this one path for Red. KNOWN, PRE-EXISTING, NOT INTRODUCED HERE: that artifact carries `mode: "readiness_dev"`, and score_gate0._verify_sources():278 requires the human artifact's `mode` to EQUAL the scoring mode -- so `human_metric_identity:red` WILL fail once a red agent run exists -- under paid_gate0 and identically under paid_gate0_v2. It does NOT fire today in either mode: _verify_sources() `continue`s past the whole identity block while `red_agent` is unreadable or hash-mismatched, so what both modes currently report for Red is `source_hash:red_agent` / `source_unreadable:red_agent` alone. Either way it is a source failure (INSUFFICIENT_DATA), fail-closed, and is prereg P1's problem to resolve, not this fixture's to paper over. miniwob_human: the v2 held-out human replay, captured by tools/capture_gate0_baseline_miniwob.py --mode paid_gate0_v2 --i-am-human, which reads the fresh seeds from the frozen score_gate0.MODES manifest and mechanically refuses both the dev and the v1-paid seed lists. Per prereg 4.1.5 + design doc:273-276 that replay happens ONLY AFTER the agent's v2 Arm W artifacts are banked; the hash below stays PENDING until then. red_agent/miniwob_agent/wake_boundary: the v2 attempt is not run; paths mirror tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1's OutputDir convention under runs/gate0_paid_v2/<arm>/ (prereg P3). live_breaker: SAME real artifact as both existing modes -- the breaker mechanism's correctness does not depend on which seed block is in play.
_source_artifact_sha256: Placeholders are inert by construction, exactly as in the two existing fixtures: eval.score_gate0._verify_sources() hits FileNotFoundError reading the path before it ever compares the hash, so these strings are never actually checked -- and none is a valid 64-hex sha256, so none can ever accidentally satisfy the check either. NO HASH HERE IS FABRICATED. The two real values are copied from no receipt: they are the digests of files that exist on disk today. red_human: the SAME digest gate0_paid_source_pins.json and gate0_readiness_dev_source_pins.json carry, because artifact_paths.red_human above points at the exact same file (David's cold attempt-1 Option-A reconstruction, 233.288s/271 actions, reports/2026-07-21-gate0-red-baseline-reconstruction.md, PR #123). live_breaker: real, deterministic, platform-independent -- no wall-clock timestamp in the content, LF-forced write, regenerable byte-exactly from tools/gate0_credit_breaker.py (reports/2026-07-19-gate0-live-breaker-dry-run.md).
_source_audit_paths: Same OutputDir/launch/world layout contract as the other two modes, under runs/gate0_paid_v2/<arm> (prereg P3) -- so a real launch with -OutputDir runs/gate0_paid_v2/<arm> lines up with zero renaming. expected_pins point at the SAME two non-appserver files paid_gate0 points at, deliberately: this fixture copies the established pattern rather than inventing a new one. Whether the paid modes should instead point at gate0_expected_pins_*.appserver.json is a real open question raised by PR #162's defect 2, and is NOT silently decided here.
_source_expected_pins_sha256: FROZEN 2026-07-28, the P4 freeze this field's previous PENDING text specified, executed after prereg P8's world-image rebuild landed (PR #180, merge b890d8c, source commit 609ab8a16ea6a7606827d08ff3b5c137cc751104). EXTRACTED FROM THE REAL FILES, never forward-declared: sha256 of eval/fixtures/gate0_expected_pins_red.json / gate0_expected_pins_miniwob.json exactly as committed on this branch, computed by eval.score_gate0._sha256()'s own method (hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes())) against the on-disk working-tree bytes, and independently cross-checked against the LF-canonical git blobs (`git show HEAD:<path> | sha256sum`) -- the two agree, as .gitattributes' `eval/fixtures/gate0_*.json text eol=lf` guarantees they must. METHOD VALIDATED AGAINST A KNOWN-GOOD PIN BEFORE ANY VALUE WAS WRITTEN HERE: the same computation reproduces the digests gate0_paid_source_pins.json and gate0_readiness_dev_source_pins.json already carry, exactly. THESE VALUES ARE IDENTICAL TO BOTH EXISTING FIXTURES', AND THAT IS CORRECT, NOT A COPY: this file's own audit_paths.{red,miniwob}.expected_pins above point at the SAME two target files those fixtures point at, so the three manifests necessarily agree -- a DIFFERENT value here would mean one of the three was wrong. The previous text's worry about 'a commitment this pre-registration has not made' is now discharged on its own terms: P8's rebuild is done and its cascade (world_image_id, host_code_sha256, image_code_sha256, miniwob tool_schema_sha256) is already inside the two hashed targets, which is why these digests are 67b95a29../8c191853.. and NOT the ff00540b../5d34c5ca.. the prereg's SS6.2 table and this field's previous text quoted -- those were the pre-rebuild values and are now superseded. THE COUPLING HAZARD THE PREVIOUS TEXT NAMED IS REAL AND IS NOW THREE-WIDE: a single edit to either target file silently invalidates THREE fixtures. Recompute all three together, in one commit, every time. NOT THE TERMINAL FREEZE: prereg SS5's COMMON_TASK_SUFFIX intervention has NOT landed (tools/gate0_appserver_arm.py:187-190 still carries the v1 suffix, and both targets' task_sha256 are still the v1 306751c3../845638c8..). When SS6.1's items 1-4 are re-frozen, both targets change again and SS6.5's second cascade pass must recompute items 5-8 AND these two -- see reports/2026-07-25-gate0-v2-prereg.md SS6.5. This freeze unblocks scoring now; it does not close P4.
